controls.title: Quarterly production access review
controls.requirement: Review all production privileged access at least every 90 days; document exceptions and control-owner sign-off.

controls.title: Backup restoration testing
controls.requirement: Successfully test production backup restoration at least every 90 days and retain the test record.

controls.title: Annual critical-vendor risk review
controls.requirement: Review critical-vendor risk at least every 365 days and retain the completed review.

evidence.title: Production privileged access review
evidence.content: Q2 production review completed. Q3 review and sign-off are not present in the evidence repository.

evidence.title: Staging access review
evidence.content: Staging review completed. This does not establish production access coverage.

evidence.title: Production restore drill
evidence.content: Production restore test succeeded; checksum verification and recovery timing recorded.

playbooks.title: Access review evidence collection
playbooks.content: Request a current production privileged-access export, review all entries, resolve exceptions and obtain identity-governance sign-off. Never revoke access automatically.

playbooks.title: Restore test evidence collection
playbooks.content: Request the latest production restoration test record. If missing or failed, propose an isolated test for platform-reliability approval. Never change production backups automatically.

playbooks.title: Vendor review evidence collection
playbooks.content: Ask third-party-risk for the current critical-vendor inventory and completed annual reviews. Missing evidence is not proof that a vendor failed its review. Never approve a vendor or publish an attestation.
